              GENERAL MECHANICS

              X-BOMB PAROL FIESTA
              Light Up Your Christmas Luck!

              1. Santa’s Daily Gift

              Check in on the promotion page once a day to claim your daily gift. A new check-in day starts at 00:00.

              On Days 1 and 2 of your streak, claim the reward shown for that day.

              From Day 3 onwards, claim Points and one Christmas Surprise Chest each day you keep your streak going. If you miss a day, your next check-in starts a new streak at Day 1.

              Open your chest to receive one randomly selected reward: Points, Instant Cash, Free Spins or Golden Draw Tickets.

              2. Parol Quest

              Sparks track your mission progress. The rate at which you earn Sparks depends on the game category or deposit mission. Before you take part, check the relevant mission for its qualifying activity, conversion rate and rewards.

              CategoryQualifying amountSparks earned
              SlotEvery ₱1 in qualifying bets1
              Live CasinoEvery ₱1 in qualifying bets0.5
              PeryaEvery ₱1 in qualifying bets1
              SportsEvery ₱1 in qualifying bets2
              Deposit (Daily Mission only)Every ₱1 successfully deposited1
              Christmas Mission

              Only qualifying bets earn Sparks for this mission. Deposits do not count. Your progress carries over from day to day during the promotion. Each time you reach a Sparks milestone, you can claim the Parols shown for that milestone.

              Daily Mission

              Place qualifying bets or make successful deposits as specified in the mission. When you reach a level, you can claim the rewards listed for it. These may be a Cash Bonus, Parols or both. Daily Mission eligibility and progress reset at 00:00 each day.

              Any Cash Bonus you claim is credited to your wallet. Before you can withdraw that bonus, you must place qualifying bets totalling at least the bonus amount after claiming it.

              3. VIP Upgrades and Mission Rewards

              If your VIP level increases during the promotion, mission rewards you have already claimed stay the same. Unclaimed mission rewards are recalculated using your new VIP level. This includes rewards you unlocked before the upgrade but have yet to claim.

              4. Parol Wish Draw

              Use your Parols to enter any of the four independent prize pools. Before each draw, check how many Parols the selected pool requires and which prizes you could win.

              Once you confirm a draw, the required Parols are deducted. The draw cannot be cancelled and the Parols spent cannot be refunded. Unused Parols expire when the promotion ends. They cannot be exchanged for cash or carried over to another promotion.

              5. Receiving Your Prizes

              Digital rewards

              Free Spins, Cash Bonuses, Vouchers and other digital prizes won in a draw are credited directly to the relevant account. Each reward’s details explain how you can use it.

              Physical prizes

              OKGAMES Customer Service will contact winners. You must reply and confirm the recipient’s name, contact details and delivery address within 28 days after the promotion ends, by 28 January 2027. If you do not complete confirmation by then, you forfeit the prize.

              OKGAMES will arrange dispatch within one month after your delivery details are confirmed. The delivery date depends on the courier. Contact Customer Service for shipping updates.

              6. General Terms

              OKGAMES reserves the right to interpret these promotion rules to the extent permitted by applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
